newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sells 0.72 pct Sibneft oil at 788 rbls/shr.
newsitem.headline: Russia sells 0.72 pct Sibneft oil at 788 rbls/shr.

text.p: Russia has sold 0.72 percent of Sibneft oil group to a foreign investor for 788 roubles per share, a spokesman for the Federal Securities Corporation said on Monday.
The price at the December 30 auction opened at 400 roubles per share. Sibneft's main operating unit is Noyabrskneftegaz.

The spokesman did not name the foreign investor who won the stake in Sibirskaya Neftynaya Kompaniya (Sibneft). He said three Russian investor groups also had bid for the stake. Bids were accepted November 27 to December 27.
Foreigners were allowed to participate in the auction because the stake, 32.52 million shares, is less than 15 percent of the company, the limit for foreign ownership in Russian oil companies.
Shares in Sibneft, one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years, are not actively traded.
Ordinary shares in Noyabrskneftegaz traded at $8.150 at 1045 GMT on Monday, up from $7.950 at Friday's close. Preferred shares had not traded after Friday's close of $5.00.
Rem Vyakhirev, chairman of Russian natural gas monopoly Gazprom, is also chairman of the board of Sibneft.
